recipes.Dockerfile.alpine:
# The V language on Alpine.
#
# Generated from manifest.json by render.py. Do not edit by hand;
# edit the manifest and re-render.
ARG USER=thevlang
ARG V_REV=master

# Stage 1 - Build the V-compiler
FROM ${USER}/vlang:alpine-build AS builder

# Redeclared here: an ARG declared before the first FROM is out of a
# build stage's scope, so it has to be repeated to be readable by RUN.
ARG V_REV

WORKDIR /opt/vlang

RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vlang/v /opt/vlang && \
    git -C /opt/vlang fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "${V_REV}" && \
    git -C /opt/vlang checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD && \
    make VFLAGS='-cc gcc' && v -version

# Stage 2 - the runtime.
FROM ${USER}/vlang:alpine-base AS runtime

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="thevlang/vlang:alpine"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="The V language on Alpine/musl, with a C compiler so V can still build programs"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/vlang/docker
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT

ENV VFLAGS="-cc gcc"

# Detect the build architecture at build time, so one Dockerfile serves
# every variant instead of relying on buildx --platform. Alpine and
# Debian do not spell the same architecture the same way.
RUN set -eu; \
    arch="$(apk --print-arch)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
        x86_64) echo "building for amd64" ;; \
        aarch64) echo "building for arm64" ;; \
        *) echo >&2 "unsupported architecture: $arch"; exit 1 ;; \
    esac

RUN apk --no-cache add \
    gcc \
    musl-dev \
    git \
    # needed for the various C headers like inttypes.h
    libc-dev \
    # Boehm GC, which V links against in its default GC mode, so without it every `v run` in this image fails the way the build does
    gc

# Copy the prebuilt V compiler
COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang /opt/vlang

# Clamp every timestamp so two builds of the same commit produce the
# same image. `git clone` and `make` both stamp files with the wall
# clock, and COPY bakes that into the layers.
ARG SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1735689600
RUN find /opt/vlang -exec touch -h -d @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} {} + && \
    newer=$(find /opt/vlang -newermt @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} -print -quit) && \
    if [ -n "$newer" ]; then \
        echo >&2 "timestamps not clamped: $newer"; exit 1; \
    fi && \
    echo "clamped to $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

WORKDIR /src

recipes.Dockerfile.debian:
# The V language on Debian, with a C compiler so V can still build programs.
#
# This image is glibc-based, which is what makes it worth having next
# to Dockerfile.alpine: a glibc program linked here runs on Debian,
# Ubuntu, Fedora and their derivatives, where a musl binary from the
# Alpine image does not.
#
# Generated from manifest.json by render.py. Do not edit by hand;
# edit the manifest and re-render.
ARG USER=thevlang
ARG V_REV=master

# Stage 1 - Build the V-compiler
FROM ${USER}/vlang:debian-build AS builder

# Redeclared here: an ARG declared before the first FROM is out of a
# build stage's scope, so it has to be repeated to be readable by RUN.
ARG V_REV

WORKDIR /opt/vlang

# CC=clang, not -cc gcc: debian-build installs clang and no gcc, and V's
# Makefile passes CC to the bootstrap. Setting VFLAGS='-cc gcc' here fails
# with "os: failed to find executable `gcc`" before the bootstrap even reaches
# cc.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vlang/v /opt/vlang && \
    git -C /opt/vlang fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "${V_REV}" && \
    git -C /opt/vlang checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD && \
    make CC=clang && v -version

# Stage 2 - the runtime.
FROM ${USER}/vlang:debian-base AS runtime

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="thevlang/vlang:debian"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="The V language on Debian/glibc, with a C compiler so V can still build programs"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/vlang/docker
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT

ENV VFLAGS="-cc gcc"

# Detect the build architecture at build time, so one Dockerfile serves
# every variant instead of relying on buildx --platform. Alpine and
# Debian do not spell the same architecture the same way.
RUN set -eu; \
    arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
        amd64) echo "building for amd64" ;; \
        arm64) echo "building for arm64" ;; \
        riscv64) echo "building for riscv64" ;; \
        ppc64el) echo "building for ppc64le" ;; \
        *) echo >&2 "unsupported architecture: $arch"; exit 1 ;; \
    esac

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        gcc \
        libc6-dev \
        git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Copy the prebuilt V compiler
COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang /opt/vlang

# Clamp every timestamp so two builds of the same commit produce the
# same image. `git clone` and `make` both stamp files with the wall
# clock, and COPY bakes that into the layers.
ARG SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1735689600
RUN find /opt/vlang -exec touch -h -d @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} {} + && \
    newer=$(find /opt/vlang -newermt @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} -print -quit) && \
    if [ -n "$newer" ]; then \
        echo >&2 "timestamps not clamped: $newer"; exit 1; \
    fi && \
    echo "clamped to $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

WORKDIR /src

recipes.Dockerfile.nix:
# V built from source on a Nix-pinned toolchain.
#
# The toolchain comes from one pinned nixpkgs revision, so it is
# reproducible in a way `apk add` / `apt install` never is. The base
# image still floats, so the rootfs is not pinned.
#
# Generated from manifest.json by render.py. Do not edit by hand.
ARG USER=thevlang
ARG V_REV=master

FROM ${USER}/vlang:nix-build AS builder

ARG V_REV

WORKDIR /opt/vlang

RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vlang/v . && \
    git fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "${V_REV}" && \
    git checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD && \
    make VFLAGS='-cc gcc' && v -version


FROM ${USER}/vlang:nix-build AS runtime

COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang /opt/vlang

# Clamp every timestamp so two builds of the same commit produce the
# same image. `git clone` and `make` both stamp files with the wall
# clock, and COPY bakes that into the layers.
ARG SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1735689600
RUN find /opt/vlang -exec touch -h -d @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} {} + && \
    newer=$(find /opt/vlang -newermt @${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} -print -quit) && \
    if [ -n "$newer" ]; then \
        echo >&2 "timestamps not clamped: $newer"; exit 1; \
    fi && \
    echo "clamped to $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="thevlang/vlang:nix"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="The V language on a pinned nixpkgs toolchain, with a C compiler so V can still build programs"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/vlang/docker
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT

ENV VFLAGS="-cc gcc"

WORKDIR /src
recipes.Dockerfile.nix.build:
# Builder image with nix base, used as the builder stage
# for multi-stage builds. Also the base for the full dev image.

ARG USER=thevlang
FROM nixos/nix:latest

# Declared inside the build stage on purpose: an ARG declared before
# the first FROM is not in scope after it, so a global declaration would
# substitute an empty string into the URL below.
ARG NIXPKGS_REV=39ad350a0602fa0a58a544344e3e9187526ea45c

ENV NIXPKGS_REV=${NIXPKGS_REV}

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="thevlang/vlang:nix-build"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="Nix toolchain image for building V from source"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/vlang/docker
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.version=${NIXPKGS_REV}

# `nix-env -f <tarball> -iA ...` installs from one pinned nixpkgs
# commit, with no channel in the way, so the same NIXPKGS_REV always
# yields the same store paths.
RUN nix-env -f "https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/archive/${NIXPKGS_REV}.tar.gz" -iA \
    git \
    make \
    gcc \
    pkg-config \
    openssl \
    sqlite

# `nix-env -i` as root installs into /root/.nix-profile, which the
# base image does not already put on PATH.
ENV PATH=/root/.nix-profile/bin:/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

WORKDIR /opt/vlang

CMD ["bash"]

recipes.Dockerfile.static:
# Minimal `scratch`-based image holding a fully static V compiler.
#
# What it is for:
#   * A base image for an already-compiled static V program:
#       FROM thevlang/vlang:static
#       COPY --from=build /app/program /usr/local/bin/program
#       CMD ["program"]
#   * `v version`.
#
# What it is deliberately not: a compiler. There is no C compiler in
# this image and V shells out to one for every `v run` / `v build`, so
# those do not work here.
#
# Generated from manifest.json by render.py. Do not edit by hand;
# edit the manifest and re-render.
ARG V_REV=master

# Stage 1 - build a static V on Alpine/musl.
FROM alpine:3.23 AS builder

RUN apk --no-cache add build-base git

WORKDIR /opt/vlang
ARG V_REV

RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vlang/v . && \
    git fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "${V_REV}" && \
    git checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD && \
    make VFLAGS='-prod' CFLAGS='-static' LDFLAGS='-static' && \
    ./v -version

FROM scratch

COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang/v /opt/vlang/v
COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang/vlib /opt/vlang/vlib
COPY --from=builder /opt/vlang/v.mod /opt/vlang/v.mod


LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="thevlang/vlang:static"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="A static V compiler in a scratch image, for v version and for running pre-compiled programs"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/vlang/docker
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT

# V writes its module cache and temp files under the home directory,
# which has to be writable - in this image that is /tmp. /opt/vlang
# goes on PATH so that `v` and the image's CMD resolve.
ENV PATH=/opt/vlang:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
    VEXE=/opt/vlang/v \
    HOME=/tmp \
    VMODULES=/tmp/vmodules \
    VTMP=/tmp/v

COPY --from=builder /etc/passwd /etc/passwd
COPY --from=builder /etc/group /etc/group
COPY --from=builder /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /src

CMD ["v", "version"]
